reasons: Geometric-mean integrity: the mean is CONJUNCTIVE precisely so a rebuttal is only as strong as its weakest axis. band-on-rounded reintroduces forgiveness at the edge, letting 0.8797 (which the conjunctive logic places below the A bar) buy an A via a display artifact. band-true keeps the mean honest to the band edge.

Reconstructability (item-3's literal goal): a skeptic with the 5 axes + the formula computes 0.8797 and asks 'is that >=0.88? No -> B.' Self-consistent. band-on-rounded forces a non-obvious 'round pct to 1dp THEN band' rule not implied by (v*s*c*r*a)^(1/5)*100, that promotes a sub-threshold value. It makes the rubric LESS reconstructable from first principles.

Governance trail: band-true was formally RATIFIED with proof; band-on-rounded was never ratified as a convention, only slipped in via a render fix. Restoring band-true honors the ratification; adopting B requires retroactively legitimizing an undocumented reversal.

Register / anti-overclaim: A26/B54/C1 is still strong; the project's frame is pessimistic-honest, not triumphalist. 10 A's that exist only by a rounding rule contradicting the documented convention is the manufactured-coverage / soft-score-targeting smell the project's own anti-patterns warn against.
